claims.citation: New York Herald, 28 May 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Brig Olive Frances (of Machiasport), Small, Marseilles
March 27, via Gibraltar April 9, with mdse, to F Talbot & Co.
May 22, lat 34 40, lon 73 30[?], spoke schr H J Haymond[?], from
Savannah for New York, 32 days out, and supplied her with
provisions.
